reviews.title: Klevv definitely makes some quality ram.
reviews.comment: I personally prefer the Klevv Cras series, but with the ram shortage and what not, I settled on the Urbanes considering the delay at time of ordering. A little bit more hot spots with the LED's on this compared to the Cras, but still a looker regardless. Hynix IC's, and have responded well with tigethering timings and an OC for more speed. Fantastic set of ram as usual from Klevv, I tend to order sets from them quite often. Took this 6000mhz set to 6400 with no issues, but unfortunately my memory controller on the 9800X3D couldn't go beyond that. Also OpenRGB compatible in case anyone was curious.

reviews.title: 48gb set working great !
reviews.comment: Just built an AMD ryzen 9 9950 x 3d PC. This memory working great with gigabyte auros 650  elite ax. The speed clocking at 6000 mhz with no problem. Working great, recommended. Rgb looks good and in sync with the rest of the rgbs.

reviews.title: Subtle Beauty
reviews.comment: I selected this because I was looking for the best bargain in a white RGB DDR5 6000MHz CL30 set of ram. Looks were were a secondary concern. After installing the ram I was amazed at how great they looked.  If you are looking for over the top RGB, this is not for you. But if you're going for a subtle understated look, this is a great choice.
reviews.author: Frank Herrera
